subject: Admin origination & onboarding checkpoint — FinoSys workspace
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@finosys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin origination & onboarding checkpoint — FinoSys workspace

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. I want to capture a tight plan for the initial workspace/tenant setup so your platform and dev teams can start integration next week. Proposed scope below — can you confirm the owners on your side and any constraints (SAML provider, KMS, IP allowlist windows)?

Scope / asks (initial):
- Create workspace "finosys-prod" in us-west and seed these admin users (see attached CSV).
- Seed two API keys: one for integration/dev (limited scope) and one for platform-batch (broader scope).
- Role matrix: we recommend two admin roles (workspace-admin, security-admin) + service role for automated job runners — see attached role matrix.
- KMS integration: do you require customer-managed keys or can we use Redwood-managed keys for the first 30 days?
- Active directory / SAML mapping: do you have attribute mappings for email/role?

Deliverables we’ll send from Redwood by EOD Tues:
- Seed invite CSV + instructions for self-service invites (attached: seed-invite-list.csv)
- Admin role matrix (attached: finosys_admin_role_matrix.xlsx)
- Temporary API key generation checklist and recommended scoping rules

Next steps / timeline
- Tue 15 Jul: Redwood seeds invites and shares temporary keys with your platform contacts (secure link)
- Wed 16 Jul: joint test of API auth + basic generation (15–30 min)
- Fri 18 Jul: sign-off on admin roster and KMS approach

Thanks — I’m looping Ben and Monica to own the seeding tasks on our side.

—
Irene Choi
Customer Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Owners: Platform lead is Samir Rao (samir@finosys.com) — he will be primary for API key receipt and IP allowlist. App security (review KMS) is Priya Menon (priya@finosys.com).
- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys for production, but can accept Redwood-managed for a 2-week staging window while we finish KMS provisioning.
- SAML: we will provide attribute mapping (email, groups) by EOD today.

Couple questions:
1) For the two API keys, can you provide example scopes? We want least-privilege by default.
2) For the seed CSV, what’s the invite expiration and resend behavior if a user doesn’t accept?

Samir will coordinate the IP allowlist window — he prefers the seed activity Wed morning PST.

Thanks — I’ll confirm Samir and Priya on this thread.

Hi all — quick response from the seeding team:

API key scopes (examples):
- integration-dev: generate:read, generate:write (limited to project "finosys-integration"); no billing access
- platform-batch: generate:write, cache:manage, metrics:read (scoped to workspace level for scheduled jobs)

Invite behavior:
- Seed invites default to 7-day expiration. We can change to 48 hours on request; resends are manual from our side (we’ll provide a small checklist to Samir).

Planned handoff actions (this message is our public checklist):
- Today (Wed 16 Jul) 11:00 PST: seed CSV import -> system will send invites (Ben to run).
- 11:30 PST: generate two temp API keys and upload to secure link (expires in 7 days).
- 14:00 PST: joint verification call (15 min) — endpoint test and permission check (Irene / Samir / Dev).

Attachments: role matrix + a short runbook (I’m attaching a trimmed runbook snapshot).
